text:
carmen_marketing: Drafting a short sales enablement brief for enterprise buyers — focus: security, SLAs, and deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Need a compact deliverable (one pager + 1 slide TL;DR). Asks: 1) benchmark narrative (latency / cost story), 2) webinar hook + slide outline, 3) inbound lead routing playbook. Can folks drop bullets/links by EOD Wed?

anita_product: +1. For benchmark narrative we should call out 99th-percentile P95/P99 latency, sustained throughput for Dedicated, and a cost-per-1M token comparison vs public providers. I can provide the baseline numbers and suggested phrasing.

mike_sales: Need a customer-facing SLA line that isn't too ops-y. Suggestion: "SLA-backed performance and enterprise support for Dedicated customers." Maybe: "Guaranteed performance SLAs and 24/7 enterprise support for Dedicated deployments." Thoughts?

elaine_security: Include KMS/HSM integration, SOC 2 Type II, audit logs, VPC peering, and data residency / GovCloud options. Also call out that Private installs can be air-gapped — important for regulated buyers. Add a short compliance checklist.

ben_eng: Would help to add a tiny diagram of routing/fallback: hosted -> dedicated (reserved GPU) -> private (customer infra) with automatic model fallback if capacity/latency issues occur. I can sketch an SVG and attach. Also I can export a reproducible benchmark script.

sam_growth: Webinar idea: "Delivering LLM features under SLA: architecture, benchmarks, and contracts." Format: 30 min (15m narrative, 10m live benchmark demo, 5m Q&A). Invite 1-2 customers as panelists. CTA: "Request enterprise evaluation" (form routes to AE). I'll draft landing copy.

carmen_marketing: For inbound routing I propose a simple play:
- self-serve signup & docs (low-touch)
- AE outreach for flagged high-usage trialers
- Solutions Eng + Legal for security / SLA / procurement requests
We should add contract size thresholds.

mike_sales: Contract thresholds suggestion: <$10k/yr = self-serve; $10k–$50k = AE outreach; >$50k = enterprise AE + solutions + account exec. Flag any mention of "private" or "SLA" as high-priority.

anita_product: Messaging iteration plan: produce two variants of the one-pager — "Technical" (SRE/Platform: details on KV cache, batching, quantization, routing) and "Executive" (Procurement/Legal: SLAs, deployment options, compliance summary). A/B test landing page conversion.

sam_growth: I'll need these assets: latency chart (png), cost table (CSV), 1-slide TL;DR (PDF), and a 30-sec benchmark video snippet. Where should we store assets? Carmen, can you create a /marketing/assets/enterprise/ folder?

ben_eng: I'll upload: latency-2026-03.csv, bench-script.sh (small reproducible script), and a compact JSON with config used (quantization, batch size). Example bench command to include in appendix:
```
# reproduce 1M token run (example)
python bench.py --model redwood-4b --seq-len 2048 --tokens 1000000 --batch 8 --quantize ptq
```

carmen_marketing: Checklist for final brief (short):
- 1-pager (exec + tech variants)
- 1-slide TL;DR
- Benchmark assets: chart + CSV + run script
- Webinar landing + CTA funnel
- Inbound routing playbook with thresholds
- Compliance callouts (KMS/HSM, SOC2, GovCloud)
- AE handoff template email

elaine_security: Also add a short blurb for RFP teams: "We provide SOC2 reports, penetration test summaries on request, and support for customer-managed KMS/HSM." Keep language non-technical but explicit.

mike_sales: AE handoff template: short paragraph + links to one-pager, bench csv, contact for solutions eng. I'll draft and post here. :thumbsup:

dev_bot: Calendar invite created: "Enterprise Briefing: Solution Brief + Webinar Plan" — Mar 27, 10:00 AM PT. Organizer: carmen_marketing.

carmen_marketing: Great — I'll assemble all inputs into a first draft one-pager and slide by Tue morning and post for review. Thanks all! :rocket:
